result_text:
A sub-landscape without a readable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent report. Its row is still rendered, with the link to its index page and the default landscape logo. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't add one for the missing-config case.

The fix is in `addSubLandscapeRow` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returned null when the file was missing or unreadable, but the row code then called `getMetadata()` on that null. It now takes the logo link only when both the config and its metadata exist. Otherwise it falls through to the existing default-logo branch. Sub-landscapes that do have a config keep their own logo.
